title: SiYangming/variant2qtl pipeline parameters
description: An end-to-end, multi-entry Nextflow pipeline for comprehensive QTL (eQTL/sQTL/pQTL) analysis, integrating diverse genetic variants (SNPs, Indels, STRs, and SVs) with automated functional annotation.

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to comma-separated file containing information about the samples in the experiment.
input.help_text: You will need to create a design file with information about the samples in your experiment before running the pipeline. Use this parameter to specify its location. It has to be a comma-separated file with 3 columns, and a header row.

genotype_input.description: Optional cohort genotype samplesheet (id; VCF and/or bed/bim/fam; optional GWAS phenotype/covariates and molQTL phenotype/covariates).
genotype_input.help_text: One row per analysis cohort. Provide either `vcf` (ingest→bed) or `bed`+`bim`+`fam`. Optional `phenotype`/`covariates` for GWAS; optional `molqtl_phenotype`/`molqtl_covariates` for OmiGA/tensorQTL cis. When set, this drives genotype ingest/QC/GWAS/molQTL inputs instead of scattered file params. FASTQC still uses `--input`.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

email.help_text: Set this parameter to your e-mail address to get a summary e-mail with details of the run sent to you when the workflow exits. If set in your user config file (`~/.nextflow/config`) then you don't need to specify this on the command line for every run.

multiqc_title.description: MultiQC report title. Printed as page header, used for filename if not otherwise specified.

gwas_benchmark_options.title: GWAS benchmark options
gwas_benchmark_options.description: Optional parallel GWAS engine benchmark (GEMMA, EMMAX, TASSEL, rMVP, OmiGA). Disabled by default.

run_gwas_benchmark.description: Run the GWAS benchmark subworkflow (gwas_benchmark_parallel). Default: false.
run_gwas_benchmark.help_text: When true, runs GEMMA LMM, EMMAX, TASSEL MLM, rMVP, and OmiGA GWAS in parallel on the supplied PLINK + phenotype inputs. Main FastQC path is unchanged when false.

gwas_benchmark_id.description: Sample meta.id for the GWAS benchmark branch.

gwas_benchmark_vcf.description: Optional VCF/VCF.GZ for TASSEL/rMVP (converted from bed if omitted).

gwas_benchmark_phenotype.description: Quantitative phenotype file (plink header: FID IID trait).

gwas_benchmark_covariates.description: Optional covariates (plink header: FID IID cov...).

gwas_benchmark_standardize.description: Pipe each engine assoc output through ASSOC_STANDARDIZE (CHR/POS/SNP/P).

gwas_benchmark_engines.description: Comma-separated GWAS engines to run (gemma,emmax,tassel,rmvp,omiga). Omit emmax on arm64 if the amd64 container hits Illegal instruction.

run_genotype_ingest.description: Run minimal genotype ingest (VCF → PLINK bed/bim/fam). Prefer over --gwas_benchmark_bed when enabled.

genotype_ingest_args.description: Extra arguments for PLINK_VCF inside genotype_ingest_harmonize.

genotype_ingest_fasta.description: Reference FASTA enabling bcftools norm (left-align / split multiallelics) before PLINK conversion.

genotype_ingest_norm_args.description: Arguments for BCFTOOLS_NORM when --genotype_ingest_fasta is set.

genotype_ingest_samples.description: Sample keep-list (one ID per line) for bcftools view before PLINK conversion.

genotype_ingest_liftover_chain.description: UCSC/Picard chain file for optional VCF liftover (requires fasta + dict too).

genotype_ingest_liftover_fasta.description: Target reference FASTA for Picard LiftoverVcf.

genotype_ingest_biallelic.description: Keep only biallelic sites before PLINK ingest (auto-on with sv_feed_ingest / str_feed_ingest). Complex SV/STR alleles are dropped.

genotype_ingest_biallelic_args.description: bcftools view args for the biallelic filter.

sv_feed_ingest.description: Mix VARIANT_SV VCF into genotype_ingest (biallelic filter). Default: false.

str_feed_ingest.description: Mix VARIANT_STR VCF into genotype_ingest (biallelic filter). Default: false.

run_genotype_qc.description: Run genotype QC (PLINK2 MAF/HWE/geno; optional het/relatedness/PCA) before GWAS/molQTL when enabled.

genotype_qc_args.description: Extra arguments for PLINK2_FILTER inside genotype_qc.

genotype_qc_run_het.description: After FILTER, remove samples with F het beyond genotype_qc_het_sd standard deviations.

genotype_qc_run_relatedness.description: After FILTER, run PLINK --genome and remove the second sample of pairs with PI_HAT ≥ genotype_qc_pi_hat.

genotype_qc_run_pca.description: Compute PLINK2 PCA on the filtered bed (emits eigenvec/eigenval).

genotype_to_bgen.description: When molQTL runs with a VCF, also export BGEN via PLINK2_VCF2BGEN.

genotype_bgen_dosage.description: VCF dosage field for BGEN export.

omiga_cis_options.title: OmiGA cis molQTL options
omiga_cis_options.description: Optional OmiGA cis-molQTL mapping (molqtl_map_omiga). Disabled by default.

run_omiga_cis.description: Run OmiGA cis-molQTL via molqtl_map_omiga. Default: false.
run_omiga_cis.help_text: When true, runs OMIGA_CIS on PLINK genotype + molecular phenotype BED/OPF. Prefer `--genotype_input` with `molqtl_phenotype` (and optional `molqtl_covariates`), or legacy `--omiga_cis_*` params. Main FastQC path is unchanged when false. Prefer a params-file for boolean flags.

omiga_cis_id.description: Sample meta.id for the OmiGA cis branch.

omiga_cis_fam.description: PLINK .fam for OmiGA cis (required when --run_omiga_cis unless --omiga_cis_use_qc_bed).

omiga_cis_vcf.description: Optional VCF for BGEN export when --genotype_to_bgen is set.

omiga_cis_use_qc_bed.description: Reuse the shared genotype_qc bed for OmiGA cis instead of --omiga_cis_bed/bim/fam.

omiga_cis_phenotype.description: Molecular phenotype BED/OPF for OmiGA cis (gene × sample).

omiga_cis_covariates.description: Optional covariates for OmiGA cis (default orientation: covariate × sample).

tensorqtl_cis_options.title: tensorQTL cis molQTL options
tensorqtl_cis_options.description: Optional tensorQTL cis-molQTL mapping (molqtl_map_tensorqtl). Disabled by default.

run_tensorqtl_cis.description: Run tensorQTL cis-molQTL via molqtl_map_tensorqtl. Default: false.
run_tensorqtl_cis.help_text: When true, runs TENSORQTL_CIS on PLINK genotype + FastQTL-style phenotype BED. Prefer `--genotype_input` with `molqtl_phenotype` (and optional `molqtl_covariates` in sample×covariate orientation), or legacy `--tensorqtl_cis_*` params. Main FastQC path is unchanged when false. Prefer a params-file for boolean flags.

tensorqtl_cis_id.description: Sample meta.id for the tensorQTL cis branch.

tensorqtl_cis_bed.description: PLINK .bed for tensorQTL cis (required when --run_tensorqtl_cis without samplesheet/QC reuse).

tensorqtl_use_qc_bed.description: Reuse the shared genotype_qc bed for tensorQTL cis instead of --tensorqtl_cis_bed/bim/fam.

tensorqtl_cis_phenotype.description: Molecular phenotype BED for tensorQTL cis (gene × sample).

tensorqtl_cis_covariates.description: Optional covariates for tensorQTL (sample × covariate orientation).

finemap_susie_options.title: SuSiE fine-mapping options
finemap_susie_options.description: Optional SuSiE fine-mapping (qtl_finemap_susie). Disabled by default.

run_finemap_susie.description: Run SuSiE fine-mapping via qtl_finemap_susie. Default: false.
run_finemap_susie.help_text: When true, runs SUSIE_FINEMAP on `--finemap_susie_sumstats`, or on cis QTL outputs if OmiGA/tensorQTL ran in the same workflow. Optional `--finemap_susie_ld` supplies an LD/correlation matrix; otherwise identity LD is used (smoke / limited interpretation).

finemap_susie_id.description: Sample meta.id for the SuSiE fine-mapping branch.

finemap_susie_sumstats.description: Association summary statistics TSV/CSV (variant_id, beta, se and/or z).

finemap_susie_ld.description: Optional square LD/correlation matrix (no header). Identity used when omitted.

coloc_options.title: QTL–GWAS coloc options
coloc_options.description: Optional coloc.abf (qtl_coloc). Disabled by default. hyprcoloc is not included.

run_coloc.description: Run QTL–GWAS coloc.abf via qtl_coloc. Default: false.
run_coloc.help_text: When true, runs COLOC_ABF on `--coloc_qtl_sumstats` and `--coloc_gwas_sumstats`, or on cis QTL outputs plus GWAS standardized tables if those branches ran.

coloc_id.description: Sample meta.id for the coloc branch.

coloc_qtl_sumstats.description: QTL summary statistics (snp/variant_id, beta, se; optional maf, n).

coloc_gwas_sumstats.description: GWAS summary statistics (snp/variant_id, beta, se; optional maf, n).

qtltools_cis_options.title: QTLtools cis options
qtltools_cis_options.description: Optional QTLtools cis-molQTL (molqtl_map_qtltools). Disabled by default.

run_qtltools_cis.description: Run QTLtools cis mapping via molqtl_map_qtltools. Default: false.
run_qtltools_cis.help_text: Prefer `--genotype_input` molqtl_phenotype[/covariates]. Converts PLINK bed to VCF inside the process. Default OFF.

qtltools_cis_id.description: Sample meta.id for the QTLtools cis branch.

qtltools_cis_bed.description: PLINK .bed for QTLtools cis (required unless --qtltools_use_qc_bed or --genotype_input).

qtltools_use_qc_bed.description: Reuse the shared genotype_qc bed for QTLtools cis instead of --qtltools_cis_bed/bim/fam.

qtltools_cis_phenotype.description: Molecular phenotype BED for QTLtools cis.

qtl_postprocess_options.title: cis-QTL postprocess options
qtl_postprocess_options.description: Optional unified cis table with Benjamini-Hochberg q-values. Disabled by default.

run_qtl_postprocess.description: Harmonise cis-QTL tables and add BH q-values. Default: false.
run_qtl_postprocess.help_text: When true, standardises `--qtl_postprocess_input` or cis outputs from OmiGA/tensorQTL/QTLtools.

qtl_postprocess_input.description: Optional cis-QTL file to standardise (else uses engine cis outputs).

phenotype_prepare_options.title: Phenotype prepare options
phenotype_prepare_options.description: Optional molecular phenotype QC to a FastQTL BED. Disabled by default.

run_phenotype_prepare.description: Intersect samples, filter missingness, INV/quantile, write FastQTL BED. Default: false.

phenotype_matrix.description: Genes×samples TSV/CSV or FastQTL BED to prepare.

phenotype_gene_bed.description: Optional chr/start/end/gene_id BED for FastQTL coordinates.

phenotype_samples.description: Optional sample keep list or PLINK FAM for intersection.

phenotype_transform.description: Per-gene inverse-normal, Bolstad quantile, or none.

phenotype_max_missing.description: Drop genes with missing fraction above this threshold.

peer_options.title: PEER covariate options
peer_options.description: Optional PEER hidden-factor covariates. Disabled by default.

run_peer.description: Infer PEER factors and emit cis-engine covariate tables. Default: false.
run_peer.help_text: Uses bioconda r-peer 1.3 / biocontainers peer:1.3. Prefers --peer_phenotype or phenotype_prepare BED. Feeds OmiGA/QTLtools (factor×sample) and tensorQTL (sample×factor) when those branches have no explicit covariates.

peer_phenotype.description: FastQTL BED for PEER (else uses phenotype_prepare output).

peer_covariates.description: Optional known covariates included in PEER.

sqtl_leafcutter_options.title: LeafCutter sQTL options
sqtl_leafcutter_options.description: Optional LeafCutter intron-ratio FastQTL BED. Disabled by default.

run_sqtl_leafcutter.description: Normalise LeafCutter counts, annotate genes, write FastQTL BED + phenotype_group. Default: false.

sqtl_genes.description: Optional gene BED for intron→gene annotation.

hyprcoloc_options.title: HyPrColoc options
hyprcoloc_options.description: Optional multi-trait colocalisation clustering. Disabled by default.

run_hyprcoloc.description: Cluster traits by pairwise ABF PP.H4 (HyPrColoc-style). Default: false.
run_hyprcoloc.help_text: Official r-hyprcoloc is not on bioconda; this module clusters long-format snp/trait/beta/se tables with Wakefield ABF.

hyprcoloc_sumstats.description: Long-format table with snp, trait, beta, se.

mashr_options.title: mashr options
mashr_options.description: Optional multi-condition mashr shrinkage. Disabled by default.

run_mashr.description: Run mashr on long-format multi-condition effects. Default: false.
run_mashr.help_text: Uses conda-forge r-mashr. Container CI is r-base stub (no biocontainers mashr image).

mashr_sumstats.description: Long-format table with snp, condition, beta, se.

metal_options.title: METAL options
metal_options.description: Optional inverse-variance meta-analysis. Disabled by default.

run_metal.description: Run inverse-variance meta across cohorts. Default: false.
run_metal.help_text: Official METAL is not on bioconda; this module implements IVW + Cochran Q on long-format snp/cohort/beta/se.

metal_sumstats.description: Long-format table with snp, cohort, beta, se.

torus_options.title: TORUS options
torus_options.description: Optional annotation enrichment prior. Disabled by default.

run_torus.description: Run TORUS-style enrichment prior from SNP z and annotations. Default: false.
run_torus.help_text: Official TORUS is not on bioconda; logistic enrichment of |z|>=2 on annotation columns.

torus_annot.description: SNP table with z plus annotation columns.

smr_options.title: SMR / HEIDI options
smr_options.description: Optional SMR and HEIDI from QTL+GWAS sumstats. Disabled by default.

run_smr.description: Run summary-stat SMR and HEIDI. Default: false.
run_smr.help_text: Official SMR binary is not on bioconda; this module implements Zhu et al. 2016 SMR/HEIDI on overlapping sumstats. Prefers --smr_*_sumstats or cis QTL + GWAS standardised tables.

smr_qtl_sumstats.description: QTL sumstats (snp, beta, se; optional gene, p).

twas_options.title: TWAS options
twas_options.description: Optional FUSION/PrediXcan/MetaXcan-style TWAS. Disabled by default.

run_twas.description: Run gene-level TWAS from QTL weights and GWAS z. Default: false.
run_twas.help_text: Accepts gene/snp/weight, MetaXcan GENE/RSID/WEIGHT, or PredictDB .db. Optional --twas_ld for FUSION-style w'Rw variance.

twas_weights.description: Gene SNP weights TSV (gene/GENE, snp/rsid, weight/WEIGHT) or PredictDB SQLite (.db).
twas_weights.help_text: `.db` files are extracted via TWAS_PREDICTDB (weights + optional extra.genename) before FUSION/MetaXcan scoring.

twas_gwas.description: GWAS sumstats (snp, beta, se or z).

twas_ld.description: Optional SNP LD matrix for FUSION-style TWAS variance.

ldsc_options.title: LDSC options
ldsc_options.description: Optional LD-score regression heritability. Disabled by default.

run_ldsc.description: Run LDSC-style heritability and optional partitioned enrichment. Default: false.
run_ldsc.help_text: Official ldsc is not pinned; chi2 ~ l2 regression with optional annotation enrichment and reference-panel LD scores.

ldsc_sumstats.description: GWAS sumstats (snp, z or beta/se, n; optional l2).

ldsc_annot.description: Optional SNP annotation table for partitioned h2.

ldsc_ldscores.description: Optional reference-panel LD scores (snp + l2), merged by SNP id.
ldsc_ldscores.help_text: Prefer this over inline sumstats l2 when using 1000G/EUR-style precomputed scores.

qtl_modality_options.title: QTL modality umbrella options
qtl_modality_options.description: Optional eQTL/sQTL/pQTL/gQTL one-switch paths. Disabled by default.

run_eqtl.description: Run eQTL: phenotype_prepare + PEER + cis engine. Default: false.

run_sqtl.description: Run sQTL: LeafCutter prepare + PEER + cis engine. Default: false.

run_pqtl.description: Run pQTL: phenotype_prepare + PEER + cis engine. Default: false.

run_gqtl.description: Run gQTL: genotype ingest (if needed) + QC + GWAS benchmark. Default: false.
run_gqtl.help_text: Convenience umbrella for complex-trait GWAS path. Uses --genotype_input or --gwas_benchmark_* like test_gwas.

qtl_modality_engine.description: Cis QTL engine for e/s/pQTL modality umbrellas.

finemap_extra_options.title: FINEMAP / CAVIAR / DAP-G options
finemap_extra_options.description: Optional FINEMAP/CAVIAR/DAP-G style PIPs. Disabled by default.

run_finemap_extra.description: Run FINEMAP/CAVIAR/DAP-G style 1-causal PIPs. Default: false.

finemap_extra_sumstats.description: Association sumstats (variant_id, beta, se or z).

finemap_extra_method.description: PIP method: finemap, caviar, or dapg.

snp_indel_options.title: SNP/Indel umbrella options
snp_indel_options.description: Optional ingest + QC + OmiGA cis in one switch. Disabled by default.

run_snp_indel.description: Run genotype ingest (if needed), QC, and OmiGA cis. Default: false.
run_snp_indel.help_text: Convenience flag for the SNP/Indel map path. Uses --genotype_input like test_omiga.

relate_options.title: Somalier relatedness options
relate_options.description: Optional Somalier extract/relate. Disabled by default.

run_relate.description: Run Somalier extract + relate. Default: false.

relate_vcf.description: Multi-sample VCF/BAM input for Somalier extract.

genotype_qc_use_somalier.description: Apply Somalier pairs as relatedness removals on QC bed. Default: false.

genotype_qc_somalier_pairs.description: Optional Somalier pairs.tsv (else uses run_relate output).

genotype_qc_somalier_relatedness.description: Relatedness threshold for Somalier outlier removal.

vcf_prep_options.title: VCF prep umbrella options
vcf_prep_options.description: Optional annotate → phase → impute one-switch path. Disabled by default.

run_vcf_prep.description: Run sequential annotate → phase → impute (each step consumes the previous VCF). Default: false.

vcf_prep_id.description: Sample meta.id for the chained VCF prep path.

vcf_prep_vcf.description: Shared input VCF when per-step VCF params are unset.

vcf_prep_feed_ingest.description: Mix run_vcf_prep output VCF into genotype_ingest. Default: false.

annotate_options.title: VCF annotation options
annotate_options.description: Optional Ensembl VEP / snpEff annotation. Disabled by default.

run_annotate.description: Run VCF annotation (VEP and/or snpEff). Default: false.

annotate_filter.description: After annotation, filter with bcftools view and/or filter_vep. Default: false.

annotate_filter_bcftools.description: Run bcftools view when annotate_filter is true.

annotate_filter_vep.description: Run filter_vep when annotate_filter is true (needs annotate_filter_vep_file).

annotate_filter_vep_file.description: Feature list for filter_vep (e.g. HGNC IDs).

phase_options.title: VCF phasing options
phase_options.description: Optional SHAPEIT5 phasing. Disabled by default.

phase_ref_vcf.description: Optional reference panel VCF for SHAPEIT5.

phase_region.description: Region for SHAPEIT5 (chr or chr:start-end). Overridden per chunk when scatter BED is set.

phase_scatter_bed.description: Optional BED to scatter SHAPEIT5 regions (bed_scatter_bedtools + gather).

phase_scatter_count.description: Number of BED chunks for phase scatter.

impute_options.title: Genotype imputation options
impute_options.description: Optional Beagle5 / Minimac4 / GLIMPSE imputation. Disabled by default.

impute_panel_tbi.description: Index for panel VCF when applicable.

impute_region.description: Region / chrom for imputation. Overridden per chunk when scatter BED is set.

impute_scatter_bed.description: Optional BED to scatter imputation regions (bed_scatter_bedtools + gather).

impute_scatter_count.description: Number of BED chunks for impute scatter.

cache_options.title: Annotation cache download options
cache_options.description: Optional Ensembl VEP / snpEff cache download. Disabled by default.

run_cache.description: Download VEP and/or snpEff annotation caches. Default: false.

cache_tools.description: Comma-separated tools to download: snpeff, ensemblvep.

cache_vep_preflight.description: Check Ensembl CHECKSUMS before VEP cache install.

impute_bam_options.title: GLIMPSE2 BAM/GL imputation options
impute_bam_options.description: Optional GLIMPSE2 imputation from BAM/CRAM or genotype-likelihood VCF. Disabled by default.

impute_bam_input.description: BAM/CRAM or genotype-likelihood VCF for GLIMPSE2.

impute_bam_fasta.description: Optional FASTA for CRAM decode / GLIMPSE2 --fasta.

impute_bam_region.description: Input/output region for GLIMPSE2 (falls back to impute_region).

impute_bam_suffix.description: Legacy GLIMPSE2 suffix (nf-core bam_vcf_impute_glimpse2 emits BCF).

impute_bam_chunk.description: Auto-chunk the reference with GLIMPSE2_chunk before phase. Default: false (use impute_bam_region as one window).

impute_bam_chunk_model.description: GLIMPSE2 chunk model when impute_bam_chunk is true.

impute_bam_split_ref.description: Split the reference panel to GLIMPSE2 binary chunks. Default: false.

fasta_index_options.title: FASTA index options
fasta_index_options.description: Optional bgzip + samtools faidx/dict for a reference FASTA. Disabled by default.

run_fasta_index.description: bgzip FASTA and build faidx/dict. Default: false.

fasta_index_fasta.description: Uncompressed or gzipped reference FASTA to index.

sv_options.title: SV calling options
sv_options.description: Optional germline SV calling. Disabled by default.

run_sv.description: Run smoove/manta/delly SV calling. Default: false.

sv_engines.description: Comma-separated SV engines: smoove, manta, delly.

sv_merge.description: When two or more SV engines emit VCFs, merge with SURVIVOR before ingest. Single-engine calls are unchanged.

str_options.title: STR genotyping options
str_options.description: Optional STR genotyping. Disabled by default.

str_engines.description: Comma-separated STR engines: expansionhunter, gangstr, hipstr, trgt.

str_merge.description: When two or more STR engines emit VCFs, merge with mergeSTR before ingest. Single-engine calls are unchanged.

reference_genome_options.title: Reference genome options
reference_genome_options.description: Reference genome related files and options required for the workflow.

genome.help_text:
If using a reference genome configured in the pipeline using iGenomes, use this parameter to give the ID for the reference. This is then used to build the full paths for all required reference genome files e.g. `--genome GRCh38`. 

See the [nf-core website docs](https://nf-co.re/usage/reference_genomes) for more details.

fasta.help_text: This parameter is *mandatory* if `--genome` is not specified. If you don't have a BWA index available this will be generated for you automatically. Combine with `--save_reference` to save BWA index for future runs.

igenomes_ignore.description: Do not load the iGenomes reference config.
igenomes_ignore.help_text: Do not load `igenomes.config` when running the pipeline. You may choose this option if you observe clashes between custom parameters and those supplied in `igenomes.config`.

igenomes_base.description: The base path to the igenomes reference files

institutional_config_options.title: Institutional config options
institutional_config_options.description: Parameters used to describe centralised config profiles. These should not be edited.
institutional_config_options.help_text: The centralised nf-core configuration profiles use a handful of pipeline parameters to describe themselves. This information is then printed to the Nextflow log when you run a pipeline. You should not need to change these values when you run a pipeline.

custom_config_version.description: Git commit id for Institutional configs.

custom_config_base.help_text: If you're running offline, Nextflow will not be able to fetch the institutional config files from the internet. If you don't need them, then this is not a problem. If you do need them, you should download the files from the repo and tell Nextflow where to find them with this parameter.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
generic_options.help_text:
These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customise some of the core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

Typically these options would be set in a Nextflow config file loaded for all pipeline runs, such as `~/.nextflow/config`.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.
publish_dir_mode.help_text: The Nextflow `publishDir` option specifies which intermediate files should be saved to the output directory. This option tells the pipeline what method should be used to move these files. See [Nextflow docs](https://www.nextflow.io/docs/latest/process.html#publishdir) for details.

email_on_fail.description: Email address for completion summary, only when pipeline fails.
email_on_fail.help_text: An email address to send a summary email to when the pipeline is completed - ONLY sent if the pipeline does not exit successfully.

plaintext_email.description: Send plain-text email instead of HTML.

max_multiqc_email_size.description: File size limit when attaching MultiQC reports to summary emails.

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.

multiqc_config.description: Custom config file to supply to MultiQC.

multiqc_logo.description: Custom logo file to supply to MultiQC. File name must also be set in the MultiQC config file

multiqc_methods_description.description: Custom MultiQC yaml file containing HTML including a methods description.

validate_params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime

pipelines_testdata_base_path.description: Base URL or local path to location of pipeline test dataset files

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename. Default is the date and time in the format yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss.

help_full.description: Display the full detailed help message.

show_hidden.description: Display hidden parameters in the help message (only works when --help or --help_full are provided).
